src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/test_fetch.py.name: Dataset download tests
src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/test_fetch.py.description: Checks the download scripts without the internet: samples keep proportions, reruns match, changed files are refused.

src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/__init__.py.name: Tests package
src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/__init__.py.description: Marks the tests folder as one package; it holds no code.

src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_agent_ac.name: Agent action tests
src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_agent_ac.description: Checks quarantine, stop, release and dismiss write and clear the right flags, and impossible changes are refused.

src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_anomaly..name: Unusual-behaviour detector tests
src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_anomaly..description: Checks the training-data cleaner never sees test rows and that normal agents cluster while attacks land outside.

src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_api.py.name: Scoring server tests
src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_api.py.description: Checks every server reply has the agreed shape, the recording mode works, and a scripted attack is caught.

src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_features.name: Behaviour summary tests
src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_features.description: Checks the one-minute summary counts planted-credential touches and messages right, and the training data looks as expected.

src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_prompt_g.name: Prompt Guard tests
src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_prompt_g.description: Checks Prompt Guard on a small made-up set, and that it skips cleanly when the real data is missing.

src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_record_t.name: Demo recorder tests
src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_record_t.description: Checks the recorder rejects bad snapshots and runs, and that the saved demo run is valid.

src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_score.py.name: Risk score tests
src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_score.py.description: Checks the risk levels, the blend of detectors, the plain reasons, the fallback rule and the speed.

src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_supervis.name: Known-attack detector tests
src/app/sentinel/_py/tests/test_supervis.description: Checks the train and test runs never overlap, every attack type is tested, and replies have the agreed shape.
